title: Monthly Trade by SITC Section (1 digit)
description: Monthly exports and imports by SITC commodity sections.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 since the data is at monthly frequency

fields.name: exports
fields.title: Exports
fields.description: [Float] The value of exports in RM millions.

fields.name: imports
fields.title: Imports
fields.description: [Float] The value of imports in RM millions.

methodology: This dataset presents monthly trade in goods, broken down by SITC section. The SITC classification is a widely used international system for classifying traded goods and services. For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/trade-technotes).
caveat: Data for the most recent two months is provisional and subject to revision in future updates.
publication: [External Trade, Mar 2026](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/trade_2026-03), the latest edition of the monthly trade statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on trade](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/external-trade).
